GMB.note: Only draft e-GP regulations and consultancies are described; no e-procurement system is said to be procured, built or in service.
Nothing on citizen or business government services online.

facts.fact: The Gambia Public Procurement Authority held an external stakeholder validation of the draft e-Government Procurement Regulations on 9 May 2024; its director general says the draft was consulted on with public and private stakeholders.
